tasks.title: Implement protected in-memory drafts and late-response session isolation
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver shared protected in-memory draft/request state used by upcoming metadata/Configuration/task flows. Session expiry/signout/user switch clears affected protected content/drafts/receipts and blocks writes/recovery; permission loss clears protected values and leaves only same-user minimal receipts when appropriate. Track exact user/application/environment/definition/schema request context so cancellation or a late old response cannot refill a different user's or environment's screen. Retain only dated allowed snapshots on transient outage, disable submissions and queue nothing until fresh state. Drafts are memory-only with unsaved navigation protection; no payload persistence. Owns state-lifetime slices of RM09-AC09, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC12, RM09-AC14, RM09-AC17, RM09-AC19 and RM10-AC28, RM10-AC29.
tasks.validation: Use existing controlled delayed-request/session tests for switch/signout/expiry/grant loss, same-user receipt restoration, definition changes and exact protected state clearing. Include keyboard/navigation protection where this primitive affects it, documentation and independent review; actual full UI journeys remain with their component owners. Verify this owner consumes only the declared medium prerequisites (WORK-155, WORK-153) and keeps the original parent accounting pool; broad provenance containers are not early completion prerequisites.
